description: This is a Python source file for a web application that provides search functionality over a code repository. It uses FastAPI for web server capabilities, FAISS for vector similarity search, SentenceTransformers for embedding generation, and includes logic for preparing a corpus from text files, handling environment variables, and serving web pages.

methods.name: read_index
methods.description: Renders the main search page using a template.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search over the corpus using either embedding similarity or keyword matching.

methods.name: advanced_search
methods.description: Performs an advanced search with different strategies via imported utility.

methods.name: open_browser
methods.description: Automatically opens the web application in a browser when the server starts.

methods.name: prepare_corpus
methods.description: Loads text files from a repository path, encodes their content into embeddings, and builds a FAISS index.
